parameters.content:
## Get an AI meeting-prep brief for your day from Google Calendar

### How it works
You walk into meetings unprepared because prepping for each one is a chore. Every morning this template reads today's events from your Google Calendar, and for each meeting a Basic LLM Chain with Google Gemini writes a one-minute prep note: the purpose, three talking points or questions to raise, and one thing to prepare or bring - inferring sensibly from the title and attendees when the invite is thin. All the notes are combined into a single email that lands before your first meeting, and on days with nothing scheduled you get a friendly "enjoy the focus time" note instead.

### Setup
1. Connect Google Calendar, Google Gemini (PaLM) API and Gmail.
2. Pick the calendar to read and set the email address to send to.
3. Adjust the schedule to your morning routine.

### Customization tips
Send the brief to Slack, or add a search step to enrich attendee context.

## 1. Read today's calendar
Run each morning and pull today's events, then shape the useful fields per meeting.

## 2. Prep each meeting (Basic LLM Chain)
Gemini writes a one-minute prep note per meeting: purpose, talking points and what to prepare.

## 3. Combine & email
All prep notes are combined into one morning email. No meetings today means a friendly note.
